scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "redis,api,worker,ui" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "redis-server --bind 127.0.0.1 --protected-mode yes --save '' --appendonly no" "cd backend && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --no-proxy-headers --port 8000 --reload" "cd backend && ./venv/bin/celery -A app.celery_app:celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
